    ...raises: [Exception, Exception, Exception], tags: [RootEffect], forbids: [].}
Keep the mixer connected until stop, retrying discovery and session failures locally. Repeated identical diagnostics are logged once; a connection is announced again only after a new diagnostic has been logged. Source   Edit
